fields.title: Polka: one client's five phone numbers
fields.summary: Customer data lives in five systems and drifts apart. Loyalty launch in seven weeks.
fields.decisionPrompt: What are we launching with in seven weeks? Name the cost of your decision.
fields.brief/company: Polka is a fictional grocery delivery service from local stores: 900 partner stores, a customer app, and a partner portal.
fields.brief/context: You are a Polka PM. A loyalty program is launching: purchase points, personal offers, push notifications, and SMS. During prep, it turned out customer data lives in five places and drifts apart. Launch is in seven weeks, a date announced by marketing.
fields.brief/objective: Launch the program so points and campaigns rely on data we can trust.
fields.brief/constraints: Seven weeks, date announced by marketing. Consents are synced manually once a month.
fields.brief/task: Decide what you launch with in seven weeks and name what remains unresolved.
fields.learnTakeaway/title: A source of truth is not assigned for all data at once
fields.learnTakeaway/body: Consolidating five systems entirely is a quarter's worth of work and almost never fits the launch deadline. What fits is choosing the attributes risk and money depend on, assigning a source for them, and automating just those. For the rest, it is more honest to show the user a known limitation than hide it behind a number you do not trust yourselves.
fields.evidenceCards/0/content: Product: phone, name, addresses. Mailing system: phone, email, consents. Support: phone, name, ticket history. Call center: own export, updated manually once a week. Analytical storage: consolidated profile, assembled by email.
fields.evidenceCards/1/content: The phone number matches across all five systems for 71% of buyers. 12% have two accounts in the product with different phone numbers and the same delivery address.
fields.evidenceCards/2/content: "Consolidation by email doesn't work: 43% of users provided an email, login is by phone. Profiles are duplicated in storage. Consolidating by phone takes three weeks, but those 12% with two phone numbers will remain."
fields.evidenceCards/3/content: Marketing consents are stored in the mailing system. Sending without consent means a fine. Consents are synced with the product manually once a month.
fields.decisionOptions/0/label: Assign sources of truth and synchronization, then launch
fields.decisionOptions/0/description: Five weeks of data work, two for the program. Tight deadline. Phone source is product, consent source is mailing system with automatic sync, consolidation by phone.
fields.decisionOptions/0/consequence: the foundation is correct. The 12% with two accounts remain as they are—they will see points separately. Risk of missing the deadline, no buffer. Discrepancy in checks will likely clear up along the way.
fields.decisionOptions/1/label: Launch on product data, everything else later
fields.decisionOptions/1/description: Two weeks. The program runs only on the profile from the product, consents are checked via manual export.
fields.decisionOptions/1/consequence: launch with a safety margin. Manual consent check is a legal risk: a monthly delay means mailings to those who opted out. Discrepancies are unresolved, program analytics will be questionable from day one.
fields.decisionOptions/2/label: Consolidation by phone plus consent automation, postpone duplicates
fields.decisionOptions/2/description: Three and a half weeks. Sources assigned for two critical attributes, 12% duplicates treated as a known limitation with a plan.
fields.decisionOptions/2/consequence: launch with a buffer. Legal risk closed. 88% of the base gets a correct program, 12% see points separately—they get an explanation and a way to merge accounts manually. Full entity resolution is next quarter.
fields.decisionOptions/3/label: Reschedule launch by a quarter, build completely
fields.decisionOptions/3/description: Plus ten weeks. Master record, entity resolution, all five systems.
fields.decisionOptions/3/consequence: correct result. Postponing the announced date, campaign shelved. Marketing loses a quarter of plans.
fields.rubric/remediation/0/gap: Fails to distinguish assigning a source from implementing it
fields.rubric/remediation/1/gap: Fails to localize data drift along the data path
fields.rubric/remediation/2/gap: Failed to link manual exports to debt accumulation
fields.rubric/remediation/3/gap: Data requirements not described in a spec before work starts
